description: A script for orchestrating Spark project tests, builds, and environment setup, including style checks, module detection, and running various test suites.

methods.name: setup_test_environ
methods.description: Sets environment variables for testing based on provided dictionary.

methods.name: determine_java_executable
methods.description: Finds the path to the Java executable used by Spark tests.

methods.name: set_title_and_block
methods.description: Sets environment variable for current block and prints a formatted title.

methods.name: run_apache_rat_checks
methods.description: Runs license checks using Apache RAT.

methods.name: run_scala_style_checks
methods.description: Runs Scala style checks via SBT.

methods.name: run_java_style_checks
methods.description: Runs Java style checks via SBT.

methods.name: run_python_style_checks
methods.description: Runs Python style checks.

methods.name: run_sparkr_style_checks
methods.description: Runs R style checks if R is available.

methods.name: build_spark_documentation
methods.description: Builds Spark documentation using Jekyll and Bundler.

methods.name: exec_maven
methods.description: Executes Maven commands.

methods.name: exec_sbt
methods.description: Executes SBT commands with output filtering.

methods.name: get_scala_profiles
methods.description: Returns SBT/Maven profiles for a given Scala version.

methods.name: switch_scala_version
methods.description: Switches code base to specified Scala version.

methods.name: get_hadoop_profiles
methods.description: Returns profiles for specified Hadoop version.

methods.name: build_spark_maven
methods.description: Builds Spark using Maven with specified profiles.

methods.name: build_spark_sbt
methods.description: Builds Spark using SBT with specified profiles.

methods.name: build_spark_unidoc_sbt
methods.description: Builds Spark unidoc API documentation via SBT.

methods.name: build_spark_assembly_sbt
methods.description: Builds Spark assembly via SBT, optionally runs Java style checks and unidoc.

methods.name: build_apache_spark
methods.description: Builds Spark with specified build tool (sbt or maven).

methods.name: detect_binary_inop_with_mima
methods.description: Detects binary incompatibilities with MiMa.

methods.name: run_scala_tests_maven
methods.description: Runs Scala tests via Maven.

methods.name: run_scala_tests_sbt
methods.description: Runs Scala tests via SBT.

methods.name: run_scala_tests
methods.description: Executes all Scala tests with specified profiles and modules.

methods.name: run_python_tests
methods.description: Runs PySpark tests with optional coverage.

methods.name: run_python_packaging_tests
methods.description: Runs Python packaging tests if not skipped.

methods.name: run_build_tests
methods.description: Runs build dependency tests.

methods.name: run_sparkr_tests
methods.description: Runs SparkR tests if R is available.

methods.name: parse_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line options for the test runner.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for orchestrating Spark tests and builds.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs doctests for utils and sparktestsupport.
